decisions.reason: The modular processing concept (MMAK) has a quantified customer result of over 600,000 euros saved per year, so its value is being realized and keeping it costs little, which makes it worth holding as an option for further modular development.
The mobile slow-speed shredder is close to the core offer and has kept its own page for two years, so its carrying cost is low and nothing signals that its value has failed to materialize.
It shares the MMAK concept, which has a documented customer reference and quantified savings, so the option is resolving favorably and fits the firm's push toward modular solutions.

The slow-speed shredders were only launched in 2024, so their prospects are still uncertain, and because they sit close to the core business they are cheap to carry while the firm learns how they perform.

The spiral shaft screens are a recent launch with no results yet and low carrying cost, so the option is worth more than its cost while the uncertainty lasts, even though the firm dropped a screen product (D) once before.
